cause: SwiftUI per-row geometry preference layout loop during native scrolling; app terminated by this runner after diagnosis, not a crash. Replaced with native scroll position observers.
followUp: Native coordinate observation alone did not resolve the later scroll loop. The final revision also removes per-scroll-phase SwiftUI state writes and fixes intrinsic row sizing; a short search-to-tail scroll regression is run before the complete light/dark flows.
finalApproach: The final app renders its bounded (maximum 1000-event) page with stable day stacks and native position observation. Full validation keeps all 24 XCUITest gestures and one in-app frame/memory sampler; the extra XCTest scroll/memory profiler is not layered on top.
